senses.definition_en: to refringe, to refract

examples.english: The light refringed off the walls.
examples.text: La luz refringida de las paredes.
examples.translation: The light refringed off the walls.

examples.english: Suppose that the violet ray contained in the heterogeneous ray FD […] is refringed in the direction DK; […]
examples.ref: 1781, Benito Bails, Elementos de Matemática, page 457:
examples.text: Supongamos que el rayo violaceo contenido en el rayo heterogeneo FD […] sea refringido en la direccion DK; […]
examples.translation: Suppose that the violet ray contained in the heterogeneous ray FD […] is refringed in the direction DK; […]

examples.english: Only simple gaseous and crystalline bodies with regular crystallization and little specific weight are refractible, or only refringe light; the opaque ones do not refringe the light.
examples.ref: 1849, Pedro Mata y Fontanet, Sinopsis Filosófica de la Química, page 454:
examples.text: Solo son refrangibles, ó solo refringen la luz, los cuerpos simples gaseosos y cristalinos de cristalizacion regular y de poco peso específico; los opacos no refringen la luz.
examples.translation: Only simple gaseous and crystalline bodies with regular crystallization and little specific weight are refractible, or only refringe light; the opaque ones do not refringe the light.

examples.english: […] in the second, then, they refringe when they become divergent, that is, they disperse and extend; but, these retractions are diametrically opposed; then, etc.
examples.ref: 1911, Juan Chiabra, Luis José Chorroarín, Elías del Carmen, La Enseñanza de la Filosofía en la Época Colonial, page 320:
examples.text: […] en la segunda, pues, se refringen cuando se hacen divergentes, es decir, se dispersan y se extienden; pero, estas retracciones se oponen diametralmente; luego, etc.
examples.translation: […] in the second, then, they refringe when they become divergent, that is, they disperse and extend; but, these retractions are diametrically opposed; then, etc.

glosses: to refringe, to refract

senses.definition_en: to reflect, to mirror, to show

examples.english: Their conscience refringes the good in a different way than mine refringes; but this refraction produces the only bond that there is between them and me: the same intransigence.
examples.ref: 1894, José Carvajal Hué, Los Anarquistas en Madrid, Madrid, Spain, page 7:
examples.text: Su conciencia refringe el bien de distinta manera que le refringe la mía; pero estí refracción produce el único lazo que hay entre ellos y yo: la misma intransigencia.
examples.translation: Their conscience refringes the good in a different way than mine refringes; but this refraction produces the only bond that there is between them and me: the same intransigence.

glosses: to reflect, to mirror, to show

senses.definition_en: for, to (expressing a recipient)

examples.english: The girl bought a Christmas gift for her grandmother.
examples.text: La niña compró un regalo de navidad para su abuela.
examples.translation: The girl bought a Christmas gift for her grandmother.

examples.english: I'd now like to perform a magic trick for you all.
examples.text: Ahora me gustaría hacer un truco de magia para ustedes.
examples.translation: I'd now like to perform a magic trick for you all.

glosses: for, to (expressing a recipient)

senses.definition_en: to, in order to, so, for (expressing the intended purpose of an action)

examples.english: I study every night tirelessly so that I get a decent job at the end of all this.
examples.text: Estudio cada noche sin descanso para conseguir un trabajo decente al fin de todo esto.
examples.translation: I study every night tirelessly so that I get a decent job at the end of all this.

examples.english: I am going to leave early to avoid traffic.
examples.text: Voy a salir temprano para evitar el tráfico.
examples.translation: I am going to leave early to avoid traffic.

glosses: to, in order to, so, for (expressing the intended purpose of an action)

senses.definition_en: by, due, due on, due by (expressing a deadline)

examples.english: I need your decision by the end of the month.
examples.text: Necesito tu decisión para fin de mes.
examples.translation: I need your decision by the end of the month.

examples.english: Your group projects are due on Friday without exception.
examples.text: Sus proyectos de grupo son para el viernes sin excepción.
examples.translation: Your group projects are due on Friday without exception.

glosses: by, due, due on, due by (expressing a deadline)

senses.definition_en: for (expressing contrast from what is expected)

examples.english: For an American tourist, he is actually pretty respectful.
examples.text: Para un turista americano, él es en realidad bastante respetuoso.
examples.translation: For an American tourist, he is actually pretty respectful.

glosses: for (expressing contrast from what is expected)

senses.definition_en: for, to, in one's opinion, as far as one is concerned (expressing an opinion, perception or perspective)

examples.english: For me, the music was the only good thing about that film.
examples.text: Para mí, la música es lo único bueno sobre esa película.
examples.translation: For me, the music was the only good thing about that film.

examples.english: As far as my brother is concerned, his wife is totally in the right.
examples.text: Para mi hermano, su esposa tiene toda la razón.

senses.definition_en: for (expressing using one's efforts for a group or an authority figure such as a sports team or a company/boss)

examples.english: My nephew plays for the Mighty Ducks' team.
examples.text: Mi sobrino juega para el equipo de los Patos Poderosos.
examples.translation: My nephew plays for the Mighty Ducks' team.

examples.english: We worked for the same boss but not at the same time.
examples.text: Trabajamos para la misma jefe aunque no al mismo tiempo.
examples.translation: We worked for the same boss but not at the same time.

examples.english: She worked for Microsoft for years, but now she works for Apple.
examples.text: Ella trabajó para Microsoft durante años, pero ahora trabaja para Apple.
examples.translation: She worked for Microsoft for years, but now she works for Apple.

glosses: for (expressing using one's efforts for a group or an authority figure such as a sports team or a company/boss)

senses.definition_en: come (used to indicate a point in time at or after which a stated event or situation occurs)

examples.translation: Come September, I'll be getting left behind.

glosses: come (used to indicate a point in time at or after which a stated event or situation occurs)
